title: 震撼的理想
content_zh:
“扑哧……”一声轻笑从秦依的口中发出。没有人比她更了解羿锋的性格。在他一说出这句话的时候，她就明白，他又要整人了。

秦依突然绽放的笑容，配合着精致无暇的容颜。让目光集中在她身上的众人陷入了失神，但却没人敢痴迷的望着她，这女人的身份，不是他们能招惹的其的。

秦依显然注意到自己的失态，她赶紧用着洁白细腻的小手掩住失笑的嘴唇。嫩白的小手压着的嘴唇，让羿锋愣愣的看着，恨不得自己就是那小手。

秦依嗔了羿锋一眼，脸上飘过一道红云。

瞧着秦依的嗔怪，那心惊魂荡的眼神，让羿锋的心猛地跳了起来，羿锋不敢相信，这时间还有如此夺人心魄的眼神。与五年前相比，秦依的绝美提升了数倍不止。

羿锋摇摇头，努力的移开在秦依身上的眼神，看着那一个个痴迷的眼神，忍不住咳嗽了几下。羿锋心底十分不满。

靠，本少都看够了，你丫的谁还敢看，我把芙蓉姐姐，凤姐啊找来给你们这群混蛋看。

要是众人知道羿锋心底在想什么，怕一个什么都不会管，先揍了再说：这混蛋，太他丫的自私和卑鄙了。

这一声咳嗽，这才让众人反应过来，把眼神从秦依身上移开，只是一个个心中多了一份惊艳，或许，他们从来没有见过如此美绝人寰的人吧。

艾伯特这时也反应过来，他看着羿凯幕笑道：“呵呵，羿爵士的公子果然厉害，那不知道寻了多少女人呢？”

羿凯幕听到艾伯特的讥讽，脸色铁青，恨不得杀了羿锋。

“啥？你说啥？艾伯特爵士，你思想怎么这么龌龊，可耻啊，太可耻了。我说的寻花问柳，不过是到处走走，看看沿路的花朵啊，风景之类的，你想到哪里去了？难道你以为，以我五年前十二岁不到的年纪，就能找女人不成。太可耻了，我都为你感到丢脸。”

羿锋一脸很厌恶的样子，微微侧了侧身子，一副要和他保持距离的样子。

众人见状，心头大骂：你这小子完全是误导别人，谁会想到你说的就是字面意思。偏偏又让别人无话可说，卑鄙，太卑鄙了。

羿凯幕这时脸色才满是笑容，看了一眼涨红着脸色的艾伯特。对着羿锋佯怒道：“住嘴，你的意思是骂艾伯特爵士脑子有病了？！艾伯特爵士，小儿不懂事，你别见怪。”

一个个翻翻白眼，明眼人都知道羿凯幕在骂艾伯特脑子有病，但是艾伯特却发泄不得，毕竟羿凯幕明面上是在教训他儿子，

羿锋自然明白父亲的意思，他很配合的说道：“父亲，我可没说他脑子有病，脑子有病的前提是，他得有脑子啊。”

一句话，顿时让所有人掩嘴而笑：这小子，骂人很牛逼啊。佩服佩服。

艾伯特虽然涵养功夫还不错，可是被一个小屁孩在众人眼前被骂成没脑子，大掉颜面，他也忘记了自己的身份，对着羿锋怒道：“废物，你找死！”

说完，他的手掌就隔着桌子向着我羿锋狠狠的扇了过来。

见状，羿锋淡淡的望了他一眼，不紧不慢的拿起杯子转了一下，撇撇嘴说道：“看你老这副猪肝脸色，我很怀疑当初你妈生你时，是不是把人丢了，把胎盘养大了。”

所有人再也忍不住，口中的酒水喷了出来：这小子，太他妈彪悍了，这骂人的水平已经达到了最高境界了，骂人不吐脏字啊。

艾伯特的身体气的颤抖了起来，他扫向羿锋脸庞的手势也快了几分。

如同羿锋预料的那样，在艾伯特的手快扇到他脸上的时候，艾伯特的手被羿凯幕一把挡住：“艾伯特爵士，你又何必和一个小孩子一般见识呢？”

感受到艾伯特那几乎要吃人的目光，羿锋丝毫不在意。他不认为艾伯特在自己父亲的寿宴上能翻起多大的风浪，更不相信他能伤害到自己。毕竟，爱脸面的父亲，不会让自己掉颜面的。这也是羿锋肆无忌惮的打击艾伯特的原因。

“咳，胎盘，别生气了。如果你不信，回家问问你妈妈就是了，我相信，她肯定会给你肯定答案的。”羿锋不紧不慢的说道。艾伯特险些没气晕过去。

“呵呵，好一副利嘴。羿世兄，你这小儿子也不简单啊。”一个中年男子看了一眼羿锋，对着羿凯幕笑道。

这突如其来的一句话，让艾伯特狠狠的瞪了羿锋一眼，不过他好像相当顾忌中年男子，居然一句话也没有再说，就坐回了座位。

羿锋自然认识这中年男子，他是布兰家族的第三子，按两家关系，羿锋该称呼他一声世叔。

羿家，布兰家都是帝国极其显赫的家族，按理说，父亲作为羿家的第二子，本该风光无限，但却因为不受羿家家主，也就是羿锋爷爷的喜欢，被发配到幕城这偏僻的地方来守祖业。这也是为什么艾伯特敢和羿凯幕作对的原因。

要不是羿凯幕不受羿家家主喜欢，凭借着羿家世子的身份，给艾伯特吃豹子胆，他也不敢和羿凯幕过不去。

与羿凯幕不同的是，布兰家主可是极其喜欢他的第三子。这也是在场所有人都对中年男子小心翼翼的原因，包括羿凯幕。

“贤弟说笑了，一个经脉俱断的废人，又哪来的不简单之说？”羿凯幕看了一眼羿锋，眼中闪过了一丝不喜。

“呵呵，萧公不也不是灵者么，你看帝国敢对他不敬的人又有几个？”中年男子摇摇头笑道。

“这逆子又哪里能和萧公相比呢？萧公可是满腹经纶、才高八斗，更能安邦治国。何况，萧公说不定哪天，一举就达到灵君也说不定。”

羿凯幕的话确实有道理。曾经，有数位才绝天下之人，在一瞬间猛的达到灵君。灵君层次的诱惑，让无数的人喜欢上诗词歌赋。再加上帝国挑选才学斐然作为官员，用作安邦治国。于是，文人这行业得到了极大的发展。颇有华夏唐宋时期文人的辉煌趋势。

其实，同样一瞬间达到灵君的还有画者，舞者，歌者。但是帝国官位的引诱，让诗者人数压他们数成。

这一切在羿锋看来，这都是必然产物。尽管这是一个实力为尊的世界，但是人也不能总是修炼，总得休息，总得找乐趣，人的本性，终根底还是为了享受。实力的修炼，不也是为了自己过的舒服。但是没有现代化技术的控魅大陆，诗词歌赋，琴棋书画，寻花问柳自然作为人寻欢作乐的首选了。诗词歌赋等不兴起才怪。

至于，某些行业的巅峰者，一瞬间达到灵君的层次，羿锋也不意外。华夏有过很多神话，有筹剑匠白日飞升，有高僧坐地飞升，有武者破碎虚空……

当一个人的灵魂达到一定境界之后，天人合一并不是不可能。而各种职业，也成了他们天人合一的桥梁。

只是，能做到天人合一的人毕竟少的可怜。甚至少的都成为传说了。所以，对他们所谓的萧公能成为灵君，羿锋嗤之以鼻。

当然，尽管是传说，但毕竟给人念想了，也就有人飞蛾扑火似地钻进了曾经传说走过的路。

不过，羿锋嘴角却闪过了一丝玩味的笑容：所谓的萧公真这么了不起吗？！要是我盗窃点唐诗宋词来和他斗一斗，不知道他会输的多么惨不忍睹。不知道世人会如何惊掉大牙。

中年男子见羿锋嘴角诡异的笑容，他眼中闪过一道惊奇，对着羿锋说道：“世侄，难道你认为萧公不能达到君级么？”

羿锋微微一笑道：“世叔可别乱说，萧公才绝天下，能达到也说不定。”

中年男子诡异一笑，这小子果然有意思，‘能达到也说不定’，他的意思不就是说，能达到很渺茫么？！这小子有点意思。

“呵呵，贤侄说的对的，不知道贤侄有什么理想呢？有没有想过超越萧公呢？”中年男子似乎对羿锋非常有兴趣，含笑的看着羿锋笑道。

他的这句话，让秦依，羿母，羿流等人的耳朵也竖了起来，他们一个个把目光集中到羿锋身上，显然他们也很想知道羿锋到底作何打算。

羿锋伸了一个懒腰，打了一个哈欠，懒洋洋的拍了一下嘴，极具懒散姿态的说道：“世叔不觉得，以我十七岁不到的年龄，回答你这么高深的问题好难么。何况，萧公是那么好超越了的吗？”

羿凯幕看着小儿子又是那副让他极度讨厌的懒散之态，他忍不住哼了一句。不过，对羿锋最后一句话却十分满意。起码这逆子没自大到说可以超越萧公的话。萧公在帝国可是作为不能超越的存在？

中年男子听到羿锋的话，脸上的笑容就更胜了：这小子用的是一句反问句，他的意思是不是说，萧公并不是不可超越呢？对，没错，这小子就是这个意思。狂，很狂。不过很有意思。

“贤侄说的有道理，不过，你还是说说你有什么理想吧？我想大家都想知道？”中年男子依旧一脸笑容的看着羿锋说道，那表情无比的和善，只是羿锋怎么看怎么不习惯。

羿母这时也插嘴道：“是啊。锋儿，你就说说，你将来想做什么，妈妈也好帮你安排。”

望着秦依，羿母一个个希望的眼神，羿锋打了一个哈欠，看了一眼满是鄙视眼神看着他的艾伯特，然后微微一笑，淡淡的笑道：“你们是要听真的呢，还是听假的呢？”
content_en:
"Puch..." A chuckle came from Qin Yi's mouth.No one understands Yifeng's character better than her.As soon as he said these words, she knew that he was going to tease her again.

Qin Yi's sudden smile matched her exquisite and flawless face.Everyone who focused their attention on her fell into a state of confusion, but no one dared to look at her obsessively. This woman's identity was not something they could offend.

Qin Yi obviously noticed her gaffe, and she quickly covered her smiling lips with her white and delicate hands.The lips pressed by the tender white hands made Yifeng stare blankly, wishing that he was the little hands.

Qin Yi gave Yifeng an angry look, and a red cloud passed over his face.

Looking at Qin Yi's scolding and frightened eyes, Yi Feng's heart jumped suddenly. Yi Feng couldn't believe that there was such a heart-stopping look at this time.Compared with five years ago, Qin Yi's beauty has improved several times.

Yifeng shook his head and tried hard to look away from Qin Yi. Looking at the obsessed eyes, he couldn't help but cough a few times.Yifeng was very dissatisfied.

Damn, I have seen enough. Who among you dares to see it? I brought Sister Furong and Sister Feng to show to you bastards.

If everyone knew what Yifeng was thinking in his heart, no one would care. They would beat him up first and then say: This bastard is so selfish and despicable.

This cough made everyone react and look away from Qin Yi, but they all felt more surprised in their hearts. Maybe they had never seen such a beautiful person before.

Albert also reacted at this time. He looked at Yi Kaimu and said with a smile: "Haha, Sir Yi's young master is indeed very powerful. How many women have he found?"

When Yi Kaimu heard Albert's sarcasm, his face turned livid and he wanted to kill Yi Feng.

"What? What are you talking about? Sir Albert, why are your thoughts so dirty? It's shameful. It's so shameful. What I said about looking for flowers and willows is just walking around and looking at the flowers and scenery along the way. Where did you think of it? Do you think that I can't find a woman at my age of less than twelve years ago five years ago? It's so shameful. I feel ashamed for you."

Yifeng looked disgusted and turned slightly to the side, as if he wanted to keep a distance from him.

When everyone saw this, they cursed in their hearts: You kid is completely misleading others. Who would have thought that what you said was literal.But to leave others speechless, despicable, so despicable.

Yi Kaimu's face was full of smiles at this time, and he glanced at Albert, who was blushing.Feigning anger at Yifeng, he said: "Shut up, do you mean to accuse Sir Albert of being mentally ill?! Sir Albert, don't be offended by this kid's ignorance."

Everyone rolled their eyes. Anyone with a discerning eye knew that Yi Kaimu was scolding Albert for being mentally ill, but Albert couldn't vent. After all, Yi Kaimu was clearly teaching his son a lesson.

Yifeng naturally understood what his father meant, and he said cooperatively: "Father, I didn't say that he has a brain disease. The prerequisite for a brain disease is that he has a brain."

One sentence immediately made everyone cover their mouths and laugh: This kid is very good at swearing.Admire and admire.

Although Albert had good self-control skills, he was scolded as brainless by a little brat in front of everyone, which caused him to lose face. He also forgot his identity and said angrily to Yifeng: "Trash, you are looking for death!"

After saying that, his palm slapped me Yifeng hard across the table.

Seeing this, Yifeng looked at him indifferently, picked up the cup and turned it around slowly, curled his lips and said: "Looking at your old pig liver expression, I doubt if your mother abandoned the person and raised the placenta when she gave birth to you."

Everyone couldn't hold back any longer, and the drinks in their mouths spurted out: This kid is so damn tough. His level of swearing has reached the highest level. He can't curse without using curse words.

Albert's body trembled with anger, and his gesture towards Yifeng's face was a little faster.

As Yi Feng expected, when Albert's hand was about to slap him in the face, Albert's hand was blocked by Yi Kaimu: "Sir Albert, why do you have to be as knowledgeable as a child?"

Feeling Albert's almost cannibalistic gaze, Yifeng didn't care at all.He didn't believe that Albert could cause much trouble at his father's birthday party, let alone that he could hurt himself.After all, a father who loves face will not let himself lose face.This is also the reason why Yi Feng attacked Albert unscrupulously.

"Ahem, placenta, don't be angry. If you don't believe it, just go home and ask your mother. I believe she will definitely give you a positive answer." Yifeng said unhurriedly.Albert almost ran out of breath and fainted.

"Haha, what a sharp tongue. Brother Yi, your little son is not simple at all." A middle-aged man glanced at Yi Feng and smiled at Yi Kaimu.

This sudden sentence made Albert glare at Yifeng fiercely, but he seemed to be quite concerned about the middle-aged man, so he sat back in his seat without saying another word.

Yifeng naturally knew this middle-aged man. He was the third son of the Bran family. According to the relationship between the two families, Yifeng should call him uncle.

The Yi family and the Bran family are both extremely prominent families in the empire. It stands to reason that as the second son of the Yi family, his father should have had great success, but because he was not liked by the head of the Yi family, Grandpa Yi Feng, he was sent to a remote place like Mucheng to guard his ancestral property.This is also the reason why Albert dared to go against Yi Kaimu.

If Yi Kaimu hadn't been disliked by the head of the Yi family, and relied on his status as the eldest son of the Yi family to give Albert the courage, he would not have dared to quarrel with Yi Kaimu.

Unlike Yi Kaimu, the head of the Bran family liked his third son very much.This is why everyone present is wary of the middle-aged man, including Yi Kaimu.

"My dear brother, you are joking. How can a useless person with all his meridians be broken?" Yi Kaimu glanced at Yi Feng, and a trace of displeasure flashed in his eyes.

"Haha, isn't Mr. Xiao a spiritual person? How many people in the empire dare to disrespect him?" The middle-aged man shook his head and smiled.

"How can this treacherous son compare with Duke Xiao? Duke Xiao is full of knowledge and talents, and he is more capable of running the country. Besides, Duke Xiao may one day become a spiritual king in one fell swoop."

What Yi Kaimu said does make sense.Once upon a time, there were several people with unparalleled talents who reached the level of Lingjun in an instant.The temptation of the spirit king level has made countless people fall in love with poetry and songs.In addition, the empire selected talented and learned officials as officials to ensure peace and stability of the country.As a result, the literati industry has developed greatly.It is quite the glorious trend of Chinese literati in the Tang and Song Dynasties.

In fact, painters, dancers, and singers also reached the Spiritual Lord in the same instant.However, the temptation of imperial official position made the number of poets outnumber them.

In Yifeng's view, all of this is an inevitable outcome.Although this is a world where strength is respected, people cannot always practice. They must rest and have fun. Human nature is ultimately for enjoyment.The cultivation of strength is not just for one's own comfort.But without modern technology in the Charming Continent, poetry, songs, music, chess, calligraphy and painting, and looking for flowers and willows are naturally the first choice for people to have fun.It would be strange if poetry, lyrics, and poetry did not rise.

As for the top people in certain industries reaching the level of Lingjun in an instant, Yifeng was not surprised.There have been many myths in China, including swordsmiths who ascended during the day, eminent monks who sat on the ground and ascended, warriors who shattered the void...

When a person's soul reaches a certain level, it is not impossible for heaven and man to become one.And various professions have also become a bridge for them to unite nature and man.

However, there are very few people who can achieve the unity of nature and man.Even the few have become legends.Therefore, Yifeng sneered at their so-called claim that Duke Xiao could become a spiritual king.

Of course, even though it is a legend, it is remembered by people after all, and some people will crawl into the path that the legend once walked like a moth to a flame.

However, a playful smile flashed across the corner of Yifeng's mouth: Is the so-called Mr. Xiao really so great?!If I stole some Tang poetry and Song lyrics to compete with him, I don’t know how miserable he would lose.I don’t know how people in the world will be shocked.

When the middle-aged man saw the strange smile on Yifeng's lips, a flash of surprise flashed in his eyes, and he said to Yifeng: "My nephew, do you think Mr. Xiao cannot reach the level of a king?"

Yifeng smiled slightly and said: "Uncle Shi, please don't talk nonsense. Mr. Xiao's talent is unparalleled in the world. Maybe he can reach it."

The middle-aged man smiled strangely. This boy was indeed interesting. "Maybe he can achieve it." Didn't he mean that it was very unlikely to achieve it?!This guy is interesting.

"Haha, my nephew is right. I wonder what my nephew's ideals are? Have you ever thought about surpassing Mr. Xiao?" The middle-aged man seemed to be very interested in Yifeng. He looked at Yifeng with a smile and said with a smile.

His words made Qin Yi, Yi's mother, Yi Liu and others' ears perk up. They all focused their attention on Yi Feng. Obviously, they also wanted to know what Yi Feng was planning.

Yifeng stretched, yawned, clapped his mouth lazily, and said in a lazy manner: "Uncle Shi, don't you think it is difficult for me to answer such a profound question for you when I am less than seventeen years old? Besides, is Mr. Xiao so easy to surpass?"

Yi Kaimu couldn't help but snort as he saw his youngest son showing such a lazy attitude that he found extremely annoying.However, I was very satisfied with Yifeng's last words.At least this traitor is not arrogant enough to say that he can surpass Mr. Xiao.Is Mr. Xiao an insurmountable being in the empire?

When the middle-aged man heard Yifeng's words, the smile on his face became even brighter: This guy used a rhetorical question. Does he mean that Mr. Xiao is not insurmountable?Yes, that's right, that's what this guy means.Crazy, very crazy.But it's interesting.

"What my nephew said makes sense, but why don't you tell me what your ideals are? I think everyone wants to know?" The middle-aged man still looked at Yifeng with a smile on his face and said, his expression was extremely kind, but Yifeng was not used to it.

Yi's mother also interrupted at this time: "Yes. Feng'er, just tell me what you want to do in the future, and my mother can help you arrange it."

Looking at Qin Yi and Yi's mother with hopeful eyes, Yi Feng yawned, glanced at Albert who was looking at him with contempt, then smiled slightly and said with a faint smile: "Do you want to hear the truth or the lie?"
